You may make one normal Move with X2 before the block. The goal is a 2D block for X1. Where do you move X2?
You ultimately want X1 on C4 to block Y1 on C3 with 2D. You must first make one block with X3. Who should X3 block first?
The goal is for X1 on C4 to block Y1 on C3 with 2D. You must first make one block with X2. Who should X2 block first?
You may move exactly one player exactly one square before the block: X2 or X4. The goal is to create a 2D block for X1. Which player do you move, and to which square?
X2 is on B4. You may move X2 exactly one square before the block. The goal is to create a 2D block for X1. Where do you move X2?
You may make one normal Move with X2 before the block. The goal is a 2D block for X1. Where do you move X2?

Right now, X3 gives one offensive assist, Y2 gives one defensive assist, and X1's block is 1D. You may move X2 exactly one square before the block. The goal is a 2D block for X1. Where do you move X2?
X2 on E2 has Guard. You may move X2 exactly one square. The goal is a 2D block for X1 against Y1. Where do you move X2?
Right now the block is -2D because Y2 assists Y1. You may move X2 exactly one square. The goal is a 2D block for X1. Where do you move X2?
The final goal is for X1 on C4 to block Y1 on C3 with 2D. You must first make one block with X2. Who should X2 block first?
The final goal is X1 on C4 against Y1 on C3 with 2D. Before that, you may make one block with either X2 or X4. Which X-player should block first?
The final goal is X1 on C4 against Y1 on C3 with 2D. First, you may make one block with either X2, who can block Y2, or X4, who can block Y3. Which player do you block with first?
The goal is still for X1 on C4 to end with a 2D block on Y1 on C3. Before X1 blocks, you may make one other block with an X-player. Which opponent should you block first?

The final goal is X1 on C4 against Y1 on C3 with 2D. Before X1 blocks, you may make one other block. You can choose to remove either Y2 or Y3 from the scrum with a suitable push. Which opponent do you block first?
X2 blocks Y2. Assume the Block die gives a normal Push. Where do you push Y2 so the following X1 -> Y1 block becomes 2D?
